sip_amount_and_payment: ₹1,000 / month, via Groww, UPI Autopay on GPay
survey_codes: Q1: 3–6m | Q3: 22–25 | Q4: Friend / colleague | Q6: Mandate limit higher | Q8: Yes – debit failed
onboarding_trigger: Colleague during lunch showed his Groww portfolio; the participant wanted to start 'financial discipline' with his first paycheck.
friction_moment: Terrified by the ₹15,000 mandate limit displayed in GPay ('Why ₹15k for a ₹1k SIP?'). Approved reluctantly. In Month 2, company salary was delayed to the 7th while SIP was set on the 5th. Debit bounced, bank debited ₹295 penalty. Groww showed 'Instalment Missed' with no retry button.
outside_app_action: Did nothing. Felt embarrassed asking his friend; feared retrying would cause another bank bounce fine. Left it untouched ('silent lapse').
quote: Groww showed ₹15,000 autopay limit on GPay for my ₹1,000 SIP. I panicked thinking they'd steal 15k. In month 2 salary was 2 days late, bank charged ₹295 penalty, and Groww gave no button to retry. I just gave up.
pm_takeaway: Critical need for clear Mandate Limit copy ('₹15,000 is NPCI upper ceiling, not your deduction') and a same-day 'Instant Pay Now / Retry Debit' button.

sip_amount_and_payment: ₹2,500 / month, via Groww, UPI Autopay on PhonePe
survey_codes: Q1: 3–6m | Q3: 22–25 | Q4: YouTube creator | Q6: Mandate limit higher + Mandate delayed | Q8: Yes – debit failed
onboarding_trigger: Watched an Ankur Warikoo video on index investing and compounding.
friction_moment: Money left bank account on Friday, but units didn't show in Groww until Wednesday evening (T+3 lag due to weekend/holiday). Spent 4 days checking frantically thinking money disappeared. Month 3 debit failed; support bot gave automated boilerplate.
outside_app_action: Revoked autopay mandate inside PhonePe settings to avoid bank charges and cancelled SIP in Groww.
quote: Money left my bank on Friday but units didn't show until Wednesday. I thought the money was lost. In month 3 the debit failed, support bot was useless, so I cancelled the autopay in PhonePe directly.
pm_takeaway: T+2/T+3 NAV settlement status must be explicitly visualized ('Money received at clearinghouse; NAV allotment on Monday evening').

survey_codes: Q1: 6–12m | Q3: 22–25 | Q4: Office talk | Q6: Date selection confusion | Q8: Yes – unexplained failure
onboarding_trigger: Office teammates bragged about small cap returns over tea breaks.
friction_moment: Picked 5th as SIP date, but his incentive-heavy salary often lands between 6th and 8th. Month 4 debit failed without an explicit SMS alert. Groww status showed 'Paused/Pending'. He had no idea if he owed money.
outside_app_action: Searched Reddit r/personalfinanceindia. Saw conflicting advice on ECS bounce fines. Kept SIP paused.
quote: My salary credits around the 7th. The SIP debited on the 5th and failed twice without explanation. Groww showed a yellow warning icon with no action. I paused it out of fear.
pm_takeaway: Dynamic 'Smart SIP Date Align' (sync with salary credit date) and transparent failure root cause explanations.

survey_codes: Q1: 3–6m | Q3: 26–30 | Q4: Friend / colleague | Q6: Mandate limit higher | Q8: Yes – unexplained failure
onboarding_trigger: Friend recommended starting SIP for 80C and long-term wealth creation.
friction_moment: Instalment 1 and 2 debited fine. Month 3 had a UPI mandate timeout at NPCI. Groww showed no notification, bank sent no SMS. The participant assumed SIP was running on autopilot until 60 days later when she noticed no debits occurred.
outside_app_action: Did nothing. Thought it was still running until the interview prompt made her check her account.
quote: I thought it was running automatically, but when I checked today it had stopped 2 months ago! Nobody sent an alert, no SMS, nothing. It just died silently.
pm_takeaway: The classic 'Silent Lapse': When a recurring debit drops at the gateway, platforms fail to alert the user proactively, leading to unintended churn.

survey_codes: Q1: 6–12m | Q3: 22–25 | Q4: My own research | Q6: Mandate limit higher + Terms unclear | Q8: Yes – debit failed
onboarding_trigger: Researched tech mutual funds after joining IT industry.
friction_moment: Terrified by PhonePe autopay screen showing 'Maximum debit: ₹25,000'. In Month 3, bank balance dipped to ₹850 before payday. Debit failed, bank levied ₹350 ECS return penalty. Felt deceived by fintech promises of 'free zero-cost investing'.
outside_app_action: Contacted Groww support; agent told him bank charges are outside Groww's purview. The participant cancelled SIP on the spot.
quote: They tell you mutual funds have no hidden fees, but my bank charged ₹350 because the SIP hit 12 hours before salary arrived. Groww support basically said 'not our problem'. So I cancelled.
pm_takeaway: Pre-debit balance check nudge at T-24h ('Ensure ₹1,000 in account by tomorrow to avoid bank bounce penalties').

sip_amount_and_payment: ₹5,000 / month, via Groww, UPI Autopay on GPay
survey_codes: Q1: 6–12m | Q3: 26–30 | Q4: YouTube creator | Q6: Mandate limit higher + Approval took long | Q8: Yes – debit failed
onboarding_trigger: Watched finance creators preaching rupee cost averaging during market volatility.
friction_moment: Mandate limit was ₹15,000. In Month 4, debit failed due to a bank server maintenance glitch on HDFC. The participant received a stern SMS warning about NACH mandate failure. Panic ensued.
outside_app_action: Searched YouTube for 'Groww SIP failed HDFC bounce charge'. Panicked and revoked autopay mandate in GPay.
quote: HDFC sent a message saying mandate failed and charges may apply. Groww app didn't explain what happened. I went into Google Pay Autopay settings and revoked the permission immediately to stop penalties.
pm_takeaway: Outside-app mandate revocation is the primary churn escape hatch when users panic about bank penalties.

survey_codes: Q1: 6–12m | Q3: 22–25 | Q4: YouTube creator | Q6: Mandate limit higher | Q8: Yes – debit failed
onboarding_trigger: Instagram reels showing how ₹1k SIP becomes ₹50 Lakhs in 20 years.
friction_moment: Month 2 debit failed because of an OTP/mandate sync error. The participant saw a red exclamation mark in Groww with the text 'Failed - Mandate Expired'. She had no idea what 'mandate' meant or how it could expire after 1 month.
outside_app_action: Planned to fix it on the weekend. Weekend passed, forgot about it, never resumed.
quote: It said 'Mandate Expired' in red. I didn't even know what a mandate was! I thought I'd ask my cousin on Sunday, forgot, and it's been paused ever since.
pm_takeaway: Jargon elimination: Replace 'Mandate Expired/Failed' with plain English ('Your automatic payment link needs a quick 1-click refresh').

survey_codes: Q1: 3–6m | Q3: 22–25 | Q4: Office talk | Q6: Mandate limit higher | Q8: Yes – unexplained failure
onboarding_trigger: Coffee-machine talk with team lead on tax saving and index compounding.
friction_moment: Month 2 payment was marked 'In Progress' for 4 days, then failed. No SMS from Groww. The participant couldn't tell if units were allotted or if money was lost. Groww didn't provide a manual payment button for the missed instalment.
outside_app_action: Did nothing. Left it in limbo. Today status shows 'Not sure if running'.
quote: The app showed 'In Progress' for 4 days then failed quietly. There was no 'Pay this month's instalment now' button. I felt if the tech is this fragile, I shouldn't trust it with my savings.
pm_takeaway: Instalment Recovery Mode: When a batch debit fails, allow an instant 1-time UPI pay for the current month without disrupting future mandate debits.

survey_codes: Q1: 3–6m | Q3: 22–25 | Q4: Family member | Q6: Nothing confused me | Q8: No, never
onboarding_trigger: Her father sat with her and helped her set up net banking mandate on salary day (10th of every month).
friction_moment: No failure experienced. Units reflect on T+2 reliably.
outside_app_action: Active, running every month. Checks portfolio once a month.
quote: My dad explained that NAV allotment takes 2 business days and told me to pick the 10th so salary is always in the bank. Smooth sailing so far.
pm_takeaway: The benchmark successful onboarding: clear timeline expectations + smart date selection (post-salary buffer) prevents 95% of churn triggers.

survey_codes: Q1: 6–12m | Q3: 26–30 | Q4: YouTube creator | Q6: Mandate limit higher + Mandate failed | Q8: Yes – debit failed
friction_moment: Setup failed twice during UPI mandate authentication. In Month 3, debit failed due to bank server downtime at 4 AM. Bank sent bounce alert. The participant spent 45 minutes on Google and Reddit researching whether CIBIL score is impacted by an SIP bounce.
outside_app_action: Immediately cancelled SIP to protect credit score.
quote: I got an SMS saying ECS mandate failed. I panicked thinking my CIBIL credit score would drop because of an investment bounce! Groww had zero reassurance on this, so I cancelled everything immediately.
pm_takeaway: Crucial reassurance copy: 'Mutual fund SIP bounces NEVER affect your CIBIL credit score (unlike loan EMIs).' Alleviates acute first-time investor panic.
